The following agreement was not correctly captured in RAN1 specification. In the current TS 38.211, there is a redundant in the current hopping pattern, which should be removed. - is the initial hop index. In addition, there was also discussion on how the hop transmission counter is mapped to actual transmission. We noticed that in TS 38.331, the slot offsets for the second and the remaining hops are provided in the sequence of ASN.1, and thus the hop index counts from 2 following the order, which is not aligned with the explanation for in TS 38.211. The clarification is needed as proposed in the TP in the end of this section. Note: the starting symbol in the slot for the remaining hops for the ASN.1 is missing, but can be directly fixed by RAN2. [7] (ran1_tdoc_chunks R1-2312652, sim=0.5627)
During the online session on Wednesday, some issues with TP 2.7.1a were highlighted. Is the whole sequence of hops supposed to fit in one single occasion of the UTW, or the is it enough that hops and UTW can be configured such that different hops can be fitted in different occasion of the UTW From the FL perspective, it should be sufficient to explain that a transmission SRS resource with tx positioning cannot be both in and out of the UTW. This will ensure the UE can expect the same level of prioritization for a whole transmission. the case of using one more multiple UTW can be resolved by the network implementation, following the UE capabilities. My proposal is thus to reword the TP as follow: TP 2.7-2 TP 2.7-2: Conclusion Comb offset hopping is not supported for positioning SRS with fre
